dialogue.content: こんばんわ相談員です。宜しくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's a pleasure to speak with you too.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 会社の上司のことで困っています
dialogue.English: I'm having some trouble with my boss at work.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、上司のどのような内容でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kind of trouble are you having with your boss?

dialogue.content: 突然、切れて怒りだすんです
dialogue.English: He suddenly snaps and gets angry.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、それは困っちゃいますね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 例えば、どんな時にそうなることが多かったりしますか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kinds of situations tend to trigger that?

dialogue.content: 仕事上の話をしていて、自分の思うようにならないと怒ります
dialogue.English: When we're discussing work and things don't go his way, he gets angry.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか、、大切な仕事中に、仕事が進まなくなっちゃいますね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult to get important work done when that happens.

dialogue.content: それはいつもですか？
dialogue.English: Does that happen all the time?

dialogue.content: いつもではないですね。
dialogue.English: Not all the time.

dialogue.content: いつ切れるかわからないんです
dialogue.English: I never know when he's going to snap.

dialogue.content: 怒りスイッチがいつ入るかわからなくて…
dialogue.English: I don't know when his "anger switch" will flip...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、突然だと怖い気もしますね
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be frightening when it's so sudden.

dialogue.content: 怒りスイッチですか・・・
dialogue.English: An "anger switch," you say...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 見えないけど、スイッチが入った瞬間がわかります(笑)
dialogue.English: I can't see it, but I can tell the moment the switch flips (laughs).

dialogue.content: それはいつ頃からですか？
dialogue.English: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: 時期というか異動されてしばらく慣れたときからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Not a specific time, but perhaps after he was transferred and had settled in for a while?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ちなみに異動されたのはいつごろでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, when did he transfer?

dialogue.content: 1年半前くらいです
dialogue.English: About a year and a half ago.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、じゃあ1年以上は怒りスイッチに困ってらっしゃるわけですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been dealing with this "anger switch" for over a year.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 最初は怒っていることきづかなかったんです
dialogue.English: At first, I didn't even realize he was angry.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 話しているうちに、ん？って思うことが増えていました
dialogue.English: But as we talked, I started to notice more and more moments where I thought, "Hmm?"

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 同僚と話したら怒っているんだよ、と言われ気付いたかんじです
dialogue.English: It was when I talked to my colleagues and they told me, "He's angry," that I finally realized it.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、怒ってることが感じ取れないって感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So is it that you have a hard time sensing that he's angry?

dialogue.content: 私が鈍感なんだとおもいます。
dialogue.English: I think I'm just not very perceptive.

dialogue.content: 同僚たちはみんな早々気付いていたようです…
dialogue.English: My colleagues all seem to have noticed it early on...

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？ちなみに、どんな感じの起こり方なんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, how does his anger manifest?

dialogue.content: 口調が変わるんです。突然
dialogue.English: His tone of voice changes. Suddenly.

dialogue.content: 顔も険しくなって
dialogue.English: His expression becomes stern, too.

dialogue.content: 手も震えていました。
dialogue.English: His hands were trembling too.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、怒り心頭って感じに思われます。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like he gets into a real fit of rage.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: その怒りスイッチが入った時、相談者さまはどう感じますか？＿
dialogue.English: When that "anger switch" flips, how do you feel?

dialogue.content: 以前は気づかなかったのでなんとも思わなかったんですが
dialogue.English: Before, when I didn't notice it, I didn't feel anything in particular.

dialogue.content: 今は、私、何か怒らせるようなこと言いました？しました？って気持ちにはなります
dialogue.English: But now, I find myself wondering, "Did I say something to make him angry? Did I do something?"

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、相談者さまは怒られて凹むって感じではなく、何怒ってんの？って感じで受けてるんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. So rather than feeling down because he's angry at you, is it more like you're thinking, "What is he angry about?"

dialogue.content: 凹むときもありますよ。だけど、あとから上司が謝ってくることがおおくて
dialogue.English: I do feel down sometimes. But often, my boss apologizes to me afterward.

dialogue.content: だから、謝るなら最初から怒らないでとおもいます。
dialogue.English: That's why I think, if you're just going to apologize, don't get angry in the first place.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、おっしゃるとおりですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. You're absolutely right.

dialogue.content: 私は気づきませんでしたが、本人は怒ってること気づいてるみたいですね
dialogue.English: I might not have noticed, but it seems he himself is aware that he's angry.

dialogue.content: そうですかー
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 例えば、どんなことで怒るんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kinds of things set him off?

dialogue.content: それがわかったら、私も楽なんですけどね〰️
dialogue.English: If I knew that, it would make my life a lot easier...

dialogue.content: 私が知りたいです
dialogue.English: I'm the one who wants to know.

dialogue.content: そうでした、失礼しました
dialogue.English: Oh, right. My apologies.

dialogue.content: 怒りスイッチはどこなんですかね？
dialogue.English: I wonder what his trigger is?

dialogue.content: ちなみに、上司の方が怒るのは、同僚の方々全員に対してですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, does your boss get angry at all of your colleagues?

dialogue.content: それもいろいろなんですよ。
dialogue.English: It varies.

dialogue.content: いる人みんなのときもあれば、特定の人のときもあって
dialogue.English: Sometimes it's at everyone present, and other times it's directed at a specific person.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、いろいろなんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So it really varies.

dialogue.content: 機嫌の浮き沈みが激しすぎてよくわかりません
dialogue.English: His moods are so up and down, I really can't figure it out.

dialogue.content: この件で、同僚の方々とはどんな話をされてますか？
dialogue.English: What do you and your colleagues talk about regarding this issue?

dialogue.content: 怒りスイッチはどこ？みたいな感じです
dialogue.English: We talk about things like, "What's his anger trigger?"

dialogue.content: ネタみたいになってます
dialogue.English: It's become a bit of a running joke.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、、皆さん困ってらっしゃるわけですね
dialogue.English: I see. So everyone is having a hard time with this.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: お話し聞いてるだけで、仕事上悪影響がでてそうな気がします
dialogue.English: Just hearing you talk about it, I get the sense that it's having a negative impact on your work.

dialogue.content: 私みたいな鈍感が余計に火に油を注いでいるとみんないいます
dialogue.English: Everyone says that someone as unperceptive as me is just adding fuel to the fire.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか、それはまた困りましたね
dialogue.English: Is that so? That's another difficult aspect of the situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: イラっとするんでしょうね、きっと
dialogue.English: I'm sure it must be irritating for him.

dialogue.content: 上司の方はどんな方なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of person is your boss?

dialogue.content: どんな方とは？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by "what kind of person"?

dialogue.content: 普通のおじさんです
dialogue.English: Just an ordinary middle-aged man.

dialogue.content: 切れやすい普通のおっさんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: A regular guy who's quick to snap?

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 皆さんがお困りであれば、会社の業績にも影響あるかんじですか？
dialogue.English: If everyone is having this trouble, is it affecting the company's performance?

dialogue.content: みんな、仕事ができる人ばかりなので今は特に影響ないんです
dialogue.English: Everyone is very capable at their jobs, so for now, there's no particular impact.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、上司がそんな感じでも、仕事に影響はないんですね、いいですね
dialogue.English: I see. So even with your boss acting like that, it's not affecting your work. That's good.

dialogue.content: そうですね。だけど、顔色を伺いながらの仕事なので、疲れますよ
dialogue.English: That's right. But since we have to work while walking on eggshells around him, it's exhausting.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そこが困ってるポイントですかね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's the main issue, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's it.

dialogue.content: お話し聞いてて、少し気になったのですが、、
dialogue.English: As I listen, there's something I'm a little curious about...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: その上司の方は、普段は上司らしいところはあるかんじですか？
dialogue.English: Does this boss have any qualities of a good boss usually?

dialogue.content: 他にも気になるところとかございますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else about him that concerns you?

dialogue.content: 仕事はできる方なんです。効率よくこなしていますし、部下をさばくのもじょうずというか
dialogue.English: He's actually very good at his job. He works efficiently and is skilled at managing his subordinates.

dialogue.content: 怒りスイッチをなんとかしてほしいくらいですかね
dialogue.English: I just wish he would do something about that "anger switch."

dialogue.content: なるほど、、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: いろいろとお話しお聞かせいただき、有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing all of that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: You're welcome.

dialogue.content: これまでのお話を要約させて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 1年半ほど異動があってから、今の上司が理由がはっきりせず怒りスイッチが入ることがある
dialogue.English: For about a year and a half, since he transferred, your current boss sometimes has his "anger switch" flipped for no clear reason.

dialogue.content: 怒ってるといっても、怒ってるのか気づかない起こり方ではあるが、本人はおこってることに気づいてる模様
dialogue.English: And while he gets angry in a way that you don't immediately notice, he himself seems to be aware that he's angry.

dialogue.content: 困ってるのは、いつなんで怒るかわからず、顔色を伺ってるのが困る
dialogue.English: The difficult part is not knowing when or why he'll get angry, which makes you feel like you have to walk on eggshells.

dialogue.content: 怒りスイッチがいつ入るのかで困ってる。
dialogue.English: You're troubled by not knowing when this "anger switch" will be triggered.

dialogue.content: ということで宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that a correct summary?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: このような事が続けば、会社の業績にもなんらかの影響が出てくると思います。
dialogue.English: If this situation continues, I believe it will eventually have some kind of impact on the company's performance.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者だけでなく、同僚の方々でも困ってる方は多いのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I imagine it's not just you, but that many of your colleagues are also struggling with this.

dialogue.content: たぶん…
dialogue.English: Probably...

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは、上司のどうなって欲しいと思ってらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to see change about your boss?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Let me see...

dialogue.content: 突然怒るのはやめましょうという感じです
dialogue.English: It's basically that I want him to stop getting angry so suddenly.

dialogue.content: はい、、有難うございます。そのお考えはごもっともだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I think that's a very reasonable thing to want.

dialogue.content: いま世の中、パワハラがすごく問題になってることもございます。
dialogue.English: These days, workplace harassment is a serious issue in society.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一度、上司の方に申し入れされるとかはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you considered trying to raise this issue with your boss?

dialogue.content: 怒っていることを伝えるということですか？
dialogue.English: You mean telling him that he's angry?

dialogue.content: なぜ、突然おこるのか、みんな迷惑しているってことをです
dialogue.English: Telling him that it's a problem for everyone, and asking why he gets angry so suddenly.

dialogue.content: それはちょっと厳しいです…
dialogue.English: That's a bit difficult for me...

dialogue.content: はい？？どの辺が厳しいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Which aspect feels difficult?

dialogue.content: 確かに迷惑ですけど、本人に面と向かって伝えるんですよね？
dialogue.English: It is a problem, but you mean telling him directly to his face, right?

dialogue.content: 例えばどのよう伝えるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: For example, how would I say it?

dialogue.content: 難しい感じですか？
dialogue.English: Does it feel difficult?

dialogue.content: 私には無理ですね
dialogue.English: It's impossible for me.

dialogue.content: どんなことならできそうですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things might feel doable for you?

dialogue.content: そんなこと言ったら仕事はやりづらいのと、さらに逆上させてしまいます
dialogue.English: If I said something like that, it would make it harder to work, and I'd just make him even more furious.

dialogue.content: どんなことができるかですか？
dialogue.English: You're asking what I can do?

dialogue.content: うーん…
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 思いつかないですね…
dialogue.English: I can't think of anything...

dialogue.content: そうですか、、逆上する感じなんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel he would fly into a rage.

dialogue.content: それはまた困りますね
dialogue.English: That would certainly be a problem.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 逆上するかはわかりませんけど、私が結構怒らせていることは先程もいったとおりで…
dialogue.English: I don't know for sure if he would fly into a rage, but as I mentioned earlier, I seem to be angering him quite a bit...

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 困ってらっしゃるのは、怒りスイッチがいつ入るかわからない
dialogue.English: What you're struggling with is not knowing when that anger switch will flip.

dialogue.content: 急に怒り出すので、困りますよね…
dialogue.English: He gets angry so suddenly, it's a real problem...

dialogue.content: ってことでしたよね？そこを知れれば、少しは回避、対処できるかんじですか？
dialogue.English: That was the issue, right? If you knew what it was, do you feel you could avoid it or deal with it better?

dialogue.content: たぶん…
dialogue.English: Probably...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、どうでしょうか？対処法は無いかなって状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Does it feel like a situation where there's no way to handle it?

dialogue.content: そうですね…わからないですね
dialogue.English: Well... I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、困りましたね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. This is a difficult situation...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: このままの状態が続くことになるますか？
dialogue.English: Do you think things will just continue as they are?

dialogue.content: なりますか？
dialogue.English: Will it?

dialogue.content: 上司が変わらなければたぶんこのままだと思います
dialogue.English: Unless my boss changes, I think it will probably stay this way.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 上司の方はどうすれば変わる可能性あるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What might make your boss change?

dialogue.content: そうですね…それを知りたいですよね
dialogue.English: Well... that's what I'd like to know.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、そこ知れる方法とかあればいいのですが・・・
dialogue.English: You're right. It would be great if there were a way to find that out...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 困りましたね・・・
dialogue.English: This is quite a dilemma...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: 何か考えられることはございませんか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything you can think of?

dialogue.content: 同僚の方々で話あわれるとか
dialogue.English: Perhaps discussing it with your colleagues.

dialogue.content: 怒るポイントですか？
dialogue.English: About his anger triggers?

dialogue.content: 皆さん同じ悩みをかかえてらっしゃるわけですよね
dialogue.English: Everyone is dealing with the same problem, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: どう対処するのがベストか、諦めるしかないか、等々皆さんで話あわれたらいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about you all discuss what the best way to handle it is, whether you have to just give up, and so on?

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 会社のこと、しごとの事で、これは重要かと思いますので、ぜひ同僚の方々と話あわれてください。
dialogue.English: Since this is an important matter concerning the company and your work, please do try to discuss it with your colleagues.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談は以上で宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that everything you wanted to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
